embeds.title: 🟡 Hola Browser for Windows Compromised to Deliver Cryptominer
embeds.description:
The Windows version of Hola Browser was compromised in a supply chain attack that delivered an undeclared Monero cryptocurrency miner executable. Sophos and other cybersecurity companies discovered the malicious file 'me.exe' during AppEsteem certification checks. Hola confirmed the supply chain compromise, which was also independently detected by Sygnia. The company reports approximately 0.1% of users were affected with no evidence of user data compromise. The miner was configured to add Windows Defender exclusions, create an auto-starting service, and run when the computer is idle.
**Sources:** BleepingComputer • 🟡 2 corroborating
**CVEs:** none • **Access:** supply chain compromise of Hola Browser distribution
**Incident date:** unknown • **Confidence:** reported
[Read source](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/hola-browser-for-windows-compromised-to-deliver-cryptominer/)
